criteria.name: Overall Grasp Success
criteria.notes: Hybrid achieved 63.33% (190/300), satisfying the >=60.0% floor but below the 70.0% unconditional gate.

criteria.name: Superiority over Reactive
criteria.pass_target: Statistically significant higher success OR equal success with >40% lower impulse
criteria.notes: Hybrid and Reactive achieved exact parity (p=1.000 McNemar test). Impulse was comparable (31.10 Ns vs 30.69 Ns). Criterion was not satisfied; report previously over-claimed conditional pass.

criteria.name: Low-Friction Handling
criteria.pass_target: Explicit stabilization (>= 40% on mu=0.35 under conservative load)
criteria.conditional_target: Documented physical failure boundary with verified mechanism
criteria.notes: Low-friction success reached 52.0% at Fn0=12.0N and 47.0% overall. Physical boundary (<0.70 ms transition vs 50 N/s rate limit) rigorously documented.

criteria.name: High-Friction Efficiency
criteria.pass_target: >= 80% success on mu=0.75 with mean Fn <= 12.0 N
criteria.notes: Success reached 83.0% (meeting >=75%), but mean normal force was 21.65 N due to emergency latching during severe shocks.

criteria.name: False Intervention Rate
criteria.notes: Measured 21.33% due to conservative pre-slip latching under sensor noise.

criteria.name: Real-Time Control Latency
criteria.notes: Measured 0.283 ms mean (p95: 0.313 ms), comfortably within 1.0 ms cycle budget.

criteria.name: Causality & Non-Leakage Contract
criteria.pass_target: Zero privileged simulation states accessible during control
criteria.conditional_target: Zero privileged simulation states accessible during control

criteria.name: Actuator Safety Bounds
criteria.pass_target: Zero violations of Fn in [3, 25] N and |dFn/dt| <= 50 N/s

rationale: Meets 4 PASS criteria and 3 CONDITIONAL PASS criteria. Criterion C2 (Superiority over Reactive) was UNMET (parity achieved, not superiority). Milestone certified as CONDITIONAL PASS with explicit limitation that actuator rate limits prevent superior proactive performance on high-speed shocks.
